title: Siren of the Cosmic Sea
description: A surreal night scene featuring a purple mermaid-like siren with a long scaled tail standing on a flower-lined shore, holding a glowing blue orb that emits radiant beams. To the left, a small sailboat carries a skeletal figure with large black eyes, while a black cat with glowing eyes sits among oversized blue and purple flowers in the foreground. The sky is filled with galaxies, nebulae, and a ringed planet.
